independence_evidence: Published by the FreeFall Literary Society of Calgary, a non-profit group that took over the magazine in 2008, from an address in Calgary; no corporate owner (https://freefallmagazine.ca/about-freefall/, https://freefallmagazine.ca/contact/).
qualifies_reason: Independent non-profit Calgary literary magazine with its Fall 2026 issue (Vol. XXXVI No. 2) out and two issues a year.
what_it_is: FreeFall is a Calgary literary magazine publishing poetry, short fiction, memoir, essays, translations and author interviews twice a year, alongside the results of its annual prose and poetry contest. Each issue runs several dozen contributors, mostly Canadian, with a commissioned cover artwork. It is for readers and writers of Canadian literary fiction and poetry.
